title: Illumina Double-Stranded DNA Dual Indexing for Ancient DNA
author: Raphaela Stahl
materials: In a modern DNA lab, use a thermocycler to amplify the reactions with the following program: During this incubation, label new 1.5mL LoBind tubes for post-purification elution (step 10).

steps.title: Calculate indexing reaction splits
steps.instruction: Determine total DNA copy number from qPCR; do not exceed 1.5×10^10 copies per indexing reaction. Based on the copy number, decide to split the indexing PCR into 2, 4, or 6 reactions (or more if needed) so that each reaction stays ≤1.5×10^10 copies. Divide the total library volume (36 µL) by the number of splits to obtain the maximum input volume per reaction. Set up at most six indexing reactions. Keep any remaining library as a backup at –20 °C and store all remaining library eluates at –20 °C for 1–2 months (short‑term) or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.

substeps.instruction: Calculate total copy number from qPCR.
Choose number of splits (2, 4, 6, or more) to keep ≤1.5×10^10 copies per reaction.
Compute input volume per reaction = 36 µL ÷ number of splits.
Prepare up to six indexing reactions.
Store backup library at –20 °C; store remaining eluates at –20 °C (short‑term) or –80 °C (long‑term).

steps.title: Assign dual index primers
steps.instruction: Assign a unique dual‑index primer pair to each library to be indexed.

steps.title: Prepare indexing PCR master mix
steps.instruction:
Calculate the total master‑mix volume required for the number of indexing reactions. In a 1.5 mL LoBind tube, combine the master mix components as follows, depending on the split scheme:
- 2‑split libraries: 78 µL master mix, 2 µL each index primer, 18 µL sample per 100 µL reaction.
- 4‑split libraries: 87 µL master mix, 2 µL each index primer, 9 µL sample per 100 µL reaction.
- 6‑split libraries: 90 µL master mix, 2 µL each index primer, 6 µL sample per 100 µL reaction.
Use 0.2 mL PCR strips for aliquoting.

substeps.instruction: Determine number of reactions (2, 4, or 6 per library).
In a LoBind tube, add the appropriate volume of master mix, 2 µL of each index primer, and the specified sample volume.

steps.title: Set up indexing PCR reactions
steps.instruction: Aliquot 100 µL of the prepared master‑mix mixture into each PCR tube (or strip well) according to the split scheme: 2, 4, or 6 reactions per library.

steps.title: Seal and ice‑keep reactions
steps.instruction: Securely close each PCR tube and, if possible, keep the reactions on ice while transferring them to the modern DNA laboratory.

steps.title: Purify indexed libraries (MinElute)
steps.instruction: Purify each indexed library using the Qiagen MinElute kit with the modifications below.

substeps.instruction: Add 650 µL PB (binding) buffer to a new 5 mL LoBind tube; add the library, vortex briefly. Combine up to four split reactions of the same library on one column; if ≥6 splits, split the mixture over two columns.
Load the PB‑library mixture onto a MinElute column and incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 15 800 × g for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through, and dispose of waste as described.
Add 700 µL PE (wash) buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 15 800 × g for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through.
Perform a dry spin at 15 800 × g for 1 minute.
Transfer the column to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

Add 50 µL EBT (elution buffer) to the membrane (or 25 µL per column if two columns were used), let stand for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 15 800 × g for 1 minute to elute. If two columns were used, pool the two 25 µL eluates to obtain a total of 50 µL.

steps.title: Dilute library for qPCR
steps.instruction: Take 2 µL of the purified indexed library and make a 1:10 dilution; then dilute that 1:10 mixture 1:100 to achieve a final 1:1000 dilution for qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL library to 18 µL diluent (1:10).
Take 1 µL of the 1:10 dilution and add to 99 µL diluent (1:100).

steps.title: Prepare qPCR master mix
steps.instruction: Calculate 20 µL of DyNAmo qPCR master mix per reaction. Set up 2 reactions per sample, 16 reactions for 7 standards in duplicate, and 2 blank reactions. Do NOT vortex the master mix; gently pipette or invert the tube several times to distribute the fluorescent dye and avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Assemble qPCR reactions
steps.instruction: In a fresh 96‑well plate, add 19 µL of the prepared qPCR master mix and 1 µL of the 1:1000‑diluted library, standard, or water to each well. Inspect wells for bubbles; if bubbles are present, briefly centrifuge the plate at maximum speed to remove them.

steps.title: Run qPCR program
steps.instruction: Amplify the qPCR reactions using the specified thermal cycling program (program details as provided in the original protocol).
